# New TunePad cell
# MUSE SAD MOOD
# Instrument chosen is piano: big piano
# MAIN IDEA IS for the sound to come across heavy, and make it feel like its struggling
# 4 different parts of a story told 
# big piano gives the affect of ambience and peace while maintaining that sombre feeling.
# part 1: mood falls
playNote(64, beats = 2) # silence for 2 beats
playNote(62, beats = 2) 
playNote(60, beats = 1)
playNote(59, beats = 1)
playNote(57, beats = 4)   # this is the low note we sink down to
rest(2)                   # a pause to inspire a breathing space, like a sigh

# part 2: trys to climb back up
playNote(57, beats = 1)
playNote(60, beats = 1)
playNote(62, beats = 2)

# part 3: but it falls down again
playNote(64, beats = 2)
playNote(62, beats = 2)
playNote(60, beats = 1)
playNote(59, beats = 1)
playNote(57, beats = 4)
rest(2)

# part 4: one last small attempt to climb, piece rests
playNote(57, beats = 1)
playNote(60, beats = 1)
playNote(62, beats = 2)
# end of piece
